meta.source: lab/rooms_corpus_extract.js and lab/rooms_corpus_stats.js on compact.json (2,128 builds)
meta.likedRule: top quarter of vanilla builds by votes (votes >= 10), ties by downloads
meta.roomRule: reader room (lib/decorate.js readLevel) with half or more of its floor under a roof, 4 to 400 m2, vanilla build, no mod piece inside; floor furniture: pivot under 0.5 m over the floor

fields.room: [a, b, rooms with both, expected by chance, lift] for every pair of vanilla furniture and decor prefabs seen together in 3 rooms or more (prefabs in 30 rooms or more); pairs never seen together are in items rarelyWith; a room's set is its floor furniture, wall pieces, lights, rugs and plants, and drapes in its doorways
fields.build: the same at build level (prefabs in 20 builds or more, vanilla builds)
fields.items: per prefab (room level): rooms, type, family, pairsWellWith [prefab, rooms, expected, lift] (8 rooms or more and lift 1.5 or more, best first), rarelyWith (never together though expected 8 or more times, then lift 0.5 or less with 8 or more expected)
fields.groups: room level, by group pair (light~seat, light~table, seat~table, table~rug and so on), most rooms first: [a, b, rooms, expected, lift]; lights are by light prefab
fields.families: material family pairs are in materials.json familyPairs
fields.lift: observed over expected: 1 is chance, above 1 they go together more often than chance, under 1 less often. Lift is high for rare pairs by chance; read it with the room count
